events.speaker: Dark Screen
events.text: July 26, 2148. At the headquarters of the Cyber Crime Investigation Bureau, I was assigned to investigate a murder that took place at an old electronics store called Rerir.

events.speaker: Dark Screen
events.text: According to the preliminary report, the victim was Evan Cole, the owner of the old electronics store. He was found dead a few hours ago.

events.speaker: Dark Screen
events.text: I quickly headed to the crime scene to gather clues.

events.speaker: Kael
events.text: The room is pretty dark. There should be a light switch somewhere around here.

events.objectiveText: Find the light switch and turn on the lights.

events.speaker: Kael
events.text: That's better. I should investigate the area.

events.speaker: Kael
events.text: The victim fell forward. It looks like he was attacked from behind. The estimated time of death is 18:30.

events.speaker: Kael
events.text: There is a black burn mark on the victim's NeuroLink.

events.speaker: Kael
events.text: He was facing the cargo box. Perhaps he had just taken something from it.

events.speaker: Kael
events.text: The crime scene has already been sealed off. Only a few residents are still around. I should ask them for some information.

events.objectiveText: Talk to the residents around the crime scene.

lines.speaker: Mira Kane
lines.text: This store has all kinds of products. If you're looking for something, I might be able to help.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: I'm not here to buy anything. I'm investigating Evan Cole. Did you know him?

lines.speaker: Mira Kane
lines.text: Evan? He was a kind person. He always helped people and kept his promises.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: Did he ever break a promise?

lines.speaker: Mira Kane
lines.text: Evan received an AeroFilter-X from an old friend. It's a rare and valuable component.

lines.speaker: Mira Kane
lines.text: He planned to donate it to the hospital.

lines.speaker: Mira Kane
lines.text: If it were me, I'd sell it.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: You didn't seem very happy about his decision.

lines.speaker: Mira Kane
lines.text: Life is hard. Why should anyone care about other people?

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: Did you notice anything unusual about him recently?

lines.speaker: Mira Kane
lines.text: No. He was just busy with his work.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: What about around 18:30? Did you see him?

lines.speaker: Mira Kane
lines.text: He was probably stocking the shelves. As far as I know, he was alone.
